about: The open-source work ob.Pal is built on, and how much we rely on each (share, out of 100). scripts/oss-audit.mjs (pnpm oss:audit) checks this list against every dependency the project declares.

upstream.name: three.js
upstream.what: The 3D engine behind the Viewer and the sims

upstream.name: Inter
upstream.what: The typeface across ob.Pal, bundled in ob.Pal Link

upstream.name: sharp and libvips
upstream.by: Lovell Fuller and the libvips team

thanks.name: Rapier
thanks.what: Pinned 0.21.0 JS/WASM multibody physics comparator and provisional lazy backend; production selection remains gated on measured browser results

thanks.name: PhysX and physx-js-webidl
thanks.what: Pinned 2.8.0 browser-only WASM comparator with reduced-coordinate articulations; MIT JavaScript bindings over BSD-3-Clause PhysX, development-only unless selected after measurement

thanks.name: Bounded custom physics comparator
thanks.what: Original sphere/box/plane comparator, common motor/suspension/buoyancy laws and synthetic SI fixtures; no external mesh, parameter file or physics implementation copied

thanks.name: Soft humanoid preview pipeline
thanks.what: Original Blender-scripted preview soft-cover humanoids in two body forms, five-finger tendon frames, curved face panels and deterministic animated light signatures; assets/blender/humanoids_soft.py and src/sim/humanoid/soft-materials.ts. Original procedural elastomer and knit finishes, both LODs; no external geometry or image textures

thanks.name: MediaPipe Tasks Vision
thanks.what: On-device Hand Landmarker and Pose Landmarker Lite, their float16 revision 1 models and self-hosted WASM runtime for camera capture

thanks.name: Body camera test fixture
thanks.what: Original AI-generated anonymous adult studio image for Pose Lite tests; prompt and provenance in tests/fixtures/camera-body.md

thanks.name: Keel, Morrow and the practice arena
thanks.what: Original Blender-scripted v3 anatomy-led humanoids, soft tendon covers and sheaths, machined joint clearances, both LODs, arena and calibration silhouette; assets/blender/humanoids.py, humanoid_clearance.py, humanoid_surfaces.py and humanoid_arena.py. Procedural obsidian, graphite, smoked-glass and elastomer kit finishes; no external geometry or textures

thanks.name: Impact Sounds
thanks.what: Sim contact foley: impactMetal_light_000 (latch), impactGeneric_light_002 (body), footstep_concrete_000 and 002 (robot feet), impactWood_medium_000 (wood); trimmed, filtered, mono WebM/Opus and MP3

thanks.name: vacuum_cleaner.wav
thanks.what: Freesound 266099: six seconds of the public HQ preview, filtered and crossfaded for the vacuum suction layer; mono WebM/Opus and MP3

thanks.name: meshoptimizer
thanks.what: Compresses the original Blender prototypes; three.js bundles its runtime decoder

thanks.name: TypeScript, Playwright and windows-rs
thanks.what: Types, the end-to-end tests, and ob.Pal Desktop's Windows calls

thanks.name: Wrangler and Workers
thanks.what: Where ob.Pal runs

thanks.name: DefinitelyTyped
thanks.what: Types for the browser extension

thanks.name: JetBrains Mono
thanks.what: Numbers and code

thanks.name: Plus Jakarta Sans
thanks.what: Headings, bundled in ob.Pal Link, and the home page's 3D letters

thanks.name: opentype.js
thanks.what: Reads the display typeface's outlines for the home page's 3D letters

thanks.name: Clipper
thanks.by: Angus Johnson, and Timo's JavaScript port
thanks.what: Merges the 3D letters' outlines into shapes three.js can fill

thanks.name: QR Code generator
thanks.what: What uqr is built on

thanks.name: jsQR
thanks.what: The phone's on-demand QR scanner where BarcodeDetector is unavailable, and our QR read-back tests

thanks.name: ZXing
thanks.what: A second reader in the same QR tests
